title: apps/sensor-service uses getRepository() in ingestion/automation/edge-device — tenant isolation bypass
rule_violated: CLAUDE.md "getRepository() is FORBIDDEN → use getScopedRepository() (tenant isolation)"
notes: Sensor ingestion path is edge-device originated — tenant binding must come from device cert CN (ADR-015 NATS identity pattern) or signed payload, not ambient context. Review each call site.
